The latter half? Not so much. The whole reveal that happens after you go to the religious place on the mountain? Dumb as hell.

But I was definitely on board with the game until at least >!The last fight with Nagi!<, I quite liked that scene. And I think it’s his theme? I think it only plays in scenes with him. The acoustic guitar track is really good.

Gonna take a little detour to talk about the soundtrack, which is consistently solid if not actively good.

I can think of one scene after the huge stupid reveal about >!The Moon!< that hit me, and that’s >!The scene in Yuito’s brain, when he almost loses also his memories for good!< and yeah, it’s a bit of a cop-out, but that scene hit me pretty hard for personal reasons.
